free_tier.stated: Free: 1 GB storage, 200 GB/month bandwidth, WebDAV and API on Free (WebDAV is listed on the Supporter table as a Free-tier feature).

egress.terms: 200 GB/month soft bandwidth cap on Free: 'Don't worry—these are soft limits. Temporary surges are fine, we won't take your site down automatically'. 200 GB/month = ~6.6 GB/day, an order of magnitude short of the 500GB-1TiB/day fetch workload.

tooling: Documented REST API: POST /api/upload (multipart, Bearer API key), plus WebDAV and an official CLI; rclone has no neocities backend but the WebDAV mount covers it.
chaining: 1 GB per site x unlimited sites per account ('Multiple Site Creation' is listed as a free feature) x unlimited free accounts. 20 TiB = 20,480 sites — operationally absurd, so this only works as a shard for a small hot set, not the archive.
limits_note: 1 GB per site on Free (50 GB Supporter); 200 GB/month bandwidth on Free; file-type restrictions on Free (no arbitrary binary types — 'No File Upload Type Restrictions' is a Supporter-only row); API requires a key per site.
